ModMetaData.name: Ammunition Manufactory
ModMetaData.author: aspctt
ModMetaData.description:
Adds the ammunition manufactory, a high-speed powered workstation for mass-producing ammunition. Unlocked with Microelectronics.
Vanilla: Mortar shells Yayo's Combat 3: Every ammo type Combat Extended: Grenades + Every ammo type your loaded weapons and turrets use
Also supports Reel's Turret Pipeline and Better Architect Menu.
